title: Test kb copies include Claude Code worktrees and fail on Windows
goal: conftest.copy_kb leaves out .claude/worktrees (the worktrees of sprint subagents), so a test that copies the kb copies one kb, not one per worktree, and stays under the Windows path limit while a subagent worktree exists; test_kb.py TestToolChecks and TestLookup pass with a worktree under .claude/worktrees.
notes: Seen while a kb-sprint research subagent ran in .claude/worktrees/agent-*: kbgit.py sync's fast tests failed 3 test_kb.py tests (shutil.Error, WinError 206 path too long, copying the worktree's kb/public/dsc/manifests files into the test's copy). copy_kb copies the whole repository less a few ignore patterns.
